signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.codeHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for your operator account.
signIn.expired: That sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.hint: Your last confirmation is too old to change the platform. Enter a fresh code from your authenticator app. The change is made right after.
stepUp.passwordHint: Your last confirmation is too old to change the platform. Enter your password again. The change is made right after.

units.title: Platform units
units.description: Every module and plugin found on this server, and whether the platform offers it. Installing or upgrading here does what the command line does.
units.businessesHint: {{enabled}} with it on, {{holding}} holding its data
units.emptyHint: The server found no modules or plugins on disk.

install.willInstall_other: This installs {{count}} units, in this order:
install.alsoNeeds: Installed together because they are required: {{list}}.
install.noData: Installing makes the unit available to businesses. No business has it on until it is switched on for them.

upgrade.noBusinesses: Only the platform's record changes: no business database needs new migrations.

uninstall.explain: The platform stops offering this unit. No business has it, so no business data is touched.

business.loadFailed: This business could not be loaded
business.unreadable: Its database could not be read: {{error}}
business.behind: Its database is behind the code on disk for: {{units}}. Use Upgrade on the Platform health page.
business.supportHint: Staff can open a business only while the business has given access. This page never bypasses that.
business.noGrant: The business has not given support access, or it has ended. Ask them to allow it under Settings, Support access.
business.notInstalled: The platform does not offer this unit yet
business.dataKept: The unit's data is kept. The business can switch it back on.
business.reasonHint: Written to the business's own audit log, where they can read it.
business.copyFailed: Could not copy: select it by hand.
business.tokenWarning: The access token works like a business sign-in for this session only. The business sees a banner while it is open and everything you do is logged.

health.title: Platform health
health.description: Readiness, migrations, backups, queues and plugins in one place.
health.readyText: This server is ready to take traffic.
health.migrationsHint: Each business has its own database; they must have every migration of the code on disk.
health.allCurrent: Every business database is up to date.
health.unreadable: These businesses could not be read: {{list}}.
health.backupsNotReported: Backups are not reported: set ZIIRA_BACKUP_DIR to the folder the backup command writes to.
health.noTasks: No recurring tasks have run yet
health.queuesUnavailable: The queue figures could not be collected.
health.noExtraFolders: No extra plugin folders are configured (ZIIRA_EXTRA_UNIT_PATHS is empty).
health.allowListOn: Production loads only plugins on ZIIRA_ALLOWED_PLUGINS.
health.noExtraPlugins: No plugins were found in them.

upgradeAll.title: Upgrade businesses
upgradeAll.explain_one: This applies the pending migrations to {{count}} business database, as the installer does.
upgradeAll.explain_other: This applies the pending migrations to {{count}} business databases, one at a time, as the installer does. A failure in one does not stop the others.
upgradeAll.allDone: Every business is up to date.
upgradeAll.someFailed_one: {{count}} business failed. Read its message, fix the cause and run it again.
upgradeAll.someFailed_other: {{count}} businesses failed. Read their messages, fix the causes and run it again.

operators.title: Operators
operators.name: Operator
operators.trailEmptyHint: Installs, upgrades and unit switches appear here.
operators.resetPasswordMessage: Their sign-ins end and their old password stops working. You will be shown a temporary password once; they must choose their own at the next sign-in.
operators.tempWarning: This is shown once. Give it to the person privately now. They must choose their own password when they sign in with it.
operators.secondFactorOffHint: Staff sign in with email and password only.
operators.descriptionCodes: Platform staff, their roles and second-factor state.
operators.createNotePassword: They choose their own password when they first sign in. If you leave the password empty, a temporary one is made and shown to you once.

account.title: My account
account.passwordHint: Your other sign-ins end when you change it.
account.newHint: At least {{min}} characters, not a common password and not your email.
account.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
account.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
account.signOutAllHint: Ends every sign-in of yours on every device, this one included.
account.forcedHint: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own now: nothing else is open until you do.

security.noSecondFactorTitle: Two-step verification is off for the Super Admin
security.noSecondFactor: Staff sign in with a password alone, so one stolen or guessed password gives control of every business. Use long, unique passwords, limit the addresses that can reach this console, and read the sign-in trail.
